title_i18n.zh: 一句话上线 AI Agent 应用：火山 Supabase + IGA Pages 全栈部署实践

excerpt_i18n.zh: 很多开发者在做全栈应用，尤其是 AI 应用时，真正耗时的地方往往不在业务代码本身。一个功能原型可能很快就能写出来：前端页面、登录注册、文件上传、数据库表、几段后端函数，再接一个大模型接口。但当它要从本地项目变成“别人能打开链接直接使用”的应用时，事情就会变复杂。
excerpt_i18n.en: Many developers find that when building full-stack applications, especially AI applications, the real time sink is not the business logic itself. A functional prototype can be quickly built: frontend pages, login and registration, file upload, database tables, a few backend functions, and a large model API connection. But when it needs to go from a local project to an app that others can open and use directly via a link, things get complicated.
excerpt_i18n.es: Muchos desarrolladores, al crear aplicaciones full-stack, especialmente aplicaciones de IA, descubren que lo que realmente consume tiempo no suele ser el código de negocio en sí mismo. Un prototipo funcional puede ser escrito rápidamente: páginas frontend, registro e inicio de sesión, carga de archivos, tablas de base de datos, algunas funciones backend y luego una interfaz para el modelo grande. Pero cuando pasa de ser un proyecto local a una aplicación que otros pueden abrir directamente a través de un enlace, las cosas se complican.

title_i18n.en: GMI Cloud, together with InfoQ and 10+ enterprises, jointly released the "White Paper on the Overseas Development of Core Elements of China's AI Industry", gathering AI industry consensus and reviewing overseas expansion methodologies.
title_i18n.es: GMI Cloud, junto con InfoQ y más de 10 empresas, lanza el Libro Blanco sobre el desarrollo de la expansión internacional de los elementos centrales de la industria china de IA, reuniendo consensos del sector y recopilando metodologías de salida al exterior.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 目前，国内AI市场竞争趋于饱和，出海成为产业突破增长天花板、抓取海外高ARPU市场红利的核心引擎。但算力供给失衡、高端硬件成本高企、全球各地差异化合规壁垒、多语言Token效率损耗、跨文化本地化适配困难等多重瓶颈，持续制约中国AI企业全球化落地效率。
excerpt_i18n.en: Currently, the domestic AI market is becoming saturated, making overseas expansion a core engine for breaking through growth ceilings and capturing high-ARPU market dividends abroad. However, multiple bottlenecks—such as imbalance in computing power supply, high costs of high-end hardware, differentiated compliance barriers across regions, multilingual token efficiency loss, and difficulties in cross-cultural localization adaptation—continue to constrain the efficiency of Chinese AI companies' global deployment.
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, la competencia en el mercado chino de IA tiende a saturarse, y la expansión internacional se ha convertido en el motor principal para que la industria supere el techo de crecimiento y aproveche los dividendos del mercado de alto ARPU en el extranjero. Sin embargo, múltiples cuellos de botella, como el desequilibrio en la oferta de capacidad computacional, los altos costos del hardware de gama alta, las barreras regulatorias diferenciadas a nivel global, la pérdida de eficiencia en tokens multilingües y las dificultades de adaptación intercultural, siguen limitando la eficiencia de la implementación global de las empresas chinas de IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: As scientific problems grow more complex and research data expands rapidly, traditional methods face efficiency bottlenecks, and AI for Science is driving a shift from experience-driven to data- and model-driven research. On July 18, at the WAIC2026 Zhongke Wenge Decision-Making Base Model Series Product Launch and AI and Decision-Making Base Model Forum, Dr. Xu Nan, researcher at the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences and CEO of Saiss Extreme Tech, introduced the latest technological progress and application cases of Panshi 2.0. As a leading "general-special integrated" scientific foundation model, Panshi 2.0 achieves native fusion of general knowledge reasoning and specialized scientific capabilities, providing unified and efficient intelligent problem-solving for complex scientific and engineering problems. Proposing the "general-special integrated" technical path, Xu Nan stated that current AI for Science foundation models mainly follow three technical paths: scenario-specific models like AlphaFold and ESM, general models enhanced by intelligent agents and scientific tools, and domain language models mapping scientific objects such as proteins and DNA into a unified language space. These paths have shown value in multiple research scenarios but still face common challenges in scientific mechanism and data fusion, reasoning logic, and result interpretability. To address these, Panshi 2.0 proposes a fourth technical path—"general-special integration"—which restructures the underlying model architecture to natively fuse general knowledge reasoning with specialized scientific capabilities.

excerpt_i18n.en: Why would a CPU chip company develop an operating system? On July 17, Cixin Technology launched its AGX Agentic Compute strategy and products including the AGX Station on the first day of WAIC 2026. More noteworthy than a desktop device supporting local large model operation, Cixin simultaneously released Agentic OS—an operating system designed for agent execution. The answer lies in: competition in agent computing is shifting from who provides computing power to who can schedule that computing power, constrain risks, and deliver it to users. What Cixin Technology aims to solve is precisely this scheduling hub that connects chips, accelerators, models, and applications. From generative AI to agents, the computing system is redefined. Over the past two years of generative AI, the core has been content production. Users give a prompt, and the model returns text, an image, or a PPT. This interaction remains human-centric: humans pose demands and are also responsible for judging results, correcting errors, and executing next steps. But once agents start to "work," the problem changes. The computing system now serves not only human-centric interaction but also extends to automated execution for agents. And what agents need is no longer a single higher-performance chip or a more powerful accelerator card. Sun Wenjian, founder and CEO of Cixin Technology, stated at the launch, "A true agent needs to understand user intent."
excerpt_i18n.es: ¿Por qué una empresa de chips CPU querría desarrollar un sistema operativo? El 17 de julio, CiXin Technology lanzó la estrategia AGX Agentic Compute en el primer día de WAIC 2026 y presentó productos como AGX Station. Más que un dispositivo de escritorio que soporte la ejecución local de grandes modelos, lo más destacable es que CiXin lanzó simultáneamente Agentic OS, un sistema operativo orientado a la ejecución de agentes. La respuesta radica en que la competencia en la computación de agentes está pasando de quién proporciona capacidad de cómputo a quién puede gestionar esa capacidad, controlar los riesgos y entregarla al usuario.
